properties.name: memoryos.redis.topology-enabled
properties.description: Whether the worker reconciles the Redis execution stream and consumer-group topology.

properties.name: memoryos.worker.enabled
properties.description: Whether the scheduled ingestion worker claims and processes durable index and cleanup work.

properties.name: memoryos.worker.poll-delay
properties.description: Fixed delay between the end of one claim loop and the start of the next, busy or idle.
